Author: dexcss
Name: Housing Unlocked
Punchline: See every snap before it happens.
Description: Housing placement toolkit for FFXIV. Know before you place: floor-snap warnings from the engine's own collision data, item-to-item snap warnings from each item's SphereCastRange block, and table-snap warnings from TableTop collision surfaces. Full position/rotation control on top, inherited from BDTH by LeonBlade. Open with /hu.
